title: AI Suggestions Homogenize Writing Toward Western Styles and Diminish Cultural Nuances

bias_targets.methodology: Conducted a cross-cultural controlled experiment comparing essays written by Indian and American participants with and without AI autocomplete suggestions. Evaluated cultural homogenization and erasure using cosine similarity of essay embeddings, predictive modeling to classify authorship (Indian vs. American), lexical diversity (Type-Token Ratio), interaction log analysis, and qualitative content analysis of cultural artifacts and expressions.
